title.en: The Annex to the Development Contract

desc.zh: 登记真实产业、土地与投资关系：矿是否在册、土地属谁、资金来自哪一国。所在国核对争点并开列担保问题，资金方自行决定限额、缩项或不再投入；条款记具体签字国，不代任何一方作答。
desc.en: Register the real industry, land and investment relations: whether the mine is registered, who owns the land, which country's money is behind it. The host audits the dispute and puts the guarantee question; the funder decides on its own to cap, shrink or stop putting in money. The terms name the countries that actually signed, and nobody answers for another.

desc.zh: 展期、撤资、缩减与公共开支各归各账：道路次序按建设能力定，展期由资金方以实付利息完成，矿难责任按册查，税权之争各自作答。执行段结束才写入完成标记，任何一方都不替另一方签字。
desc.en: Rescheduling, disinvestment, shrinkage and public spending each keep their own ledger: the road order follows building capacity, the reschedule is paid from the funder's interest, the accident liability is checked against the register, and the tariff dispute is answered on each side. The completion mark is written only when the execution segment ends, and nobody signs for another.

desc.zh: 检查项目结局与复议：拆期与否、退出之后的账、两份不同的胜利，最后按各自实际落款与实付写下余波。完整协议、有限项目、保留现状、主动退出、履约失败与无从谈判都是正结局，正常游戏继续。
desc.en: Examine how the project ends and review it: the phase split, the ledger after withdrawal, two different victories, and finally the aftermath written from each side's actual signature and actual payment. Full agreement, limited project, status quo, withdrawal, fulfillment failed and no talks are all ordinary endings, and normal play continues.

desc.zh: 勘探队报来的矿脉落在契约之外：所在国须先核对真实产业、土地与投资关系——矿业是否真的在册，土地属于谁，资金来自哪一国。没有实际的对方，就不虚构一笔跨国债务。
desc.en: The surveyed lode falls outside the signed contract: the host country must first audit the real industry, land and investment relations - whether the mine is actually registered, who owns the land, and which country's money is behind it. Without a real counterparty, no cross-country debt is invented.

desc.zh: 资金方的账房不肯为看不到回报的工程无穷付款：或以限额担保只担核定的份额，或要求把工程缩到已拨资金能承受的规模，或拒绝再投入新资金。担保不改变所在国的地权与税收，也不替所在国作答。

title.en: The Mining Town Rejects a Blank Contract

The host decides whom to bind - labor and villages, the shareholders, or a full town assembly. The terms are written openly; nobody signs for another.

title.en: A Reschedule the Budget Can Carry

desc.zh: 资金方按自己的预算摊牌：以实付利息把债务展期，或改由承包人垫资而债权不动，或停止一切未拨资金。没有一项让所在国多付一分，也没有一项替他国决定；展期的代价由资金方国库实付。
desc.en: The funder lays its own budget on the table: reschedule the debt against interest actually paid, shift the works onto the contractor's advances while the claim stands still, or stop every undisbursed line. None of it charges the host a coin more, and none of it decides for another country; the reschedule's price is paid from the funder's own treasury.

title.en: Splitting the Works into Two Phases

desc.zh: 全部工程一次做完，公共责任也一次背全。所在国或把开发拆成两期——第一期只做已拨资金能核的部分，公共设施随期验收；或坚持一次建成而自担其险。拆与不拆都记入契约，余下的账到结算时再算。
desc.en: Building everything at once also binds the public duties at once. The host may split the works into two phases - the first only what the disbursed funds can audit, public facilities inspected phase by phase - or insist on building at once and carry the risk itself. Either way the choice enters the contract, and the remaining accounts wait for settlement.
